> **SUPERSEDED 2026-05-24** by the single-resolver form now in [Driver → Current executable phase](cp-net-1-driver.md). The original v1 contract below baked in `dns-server,10.254.0.1,1.1.1.1` (dual-resolver with external public fallback). That form contradicts the tightened I-DNS-DUAL-RESOLVER-1 invariant: external public resolvers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8) are bootstrap-only or break-glass, NOT steady-state CT/scope policy. The v2 contract in the Driver emits **single resolver only** (`dns-server,10.254.0.1`).

When a phase becomes the next-up executable phase, its contract moves from this section to the [Driver](cp-net-1-driver.md). Until then, the architectural envelope lives here and in the Overview's §1 rollout sequence.
Detailed step contracts pair-reviewed pending closer to date. The consolidated 4A debt register in the [Driver](cp-net-1-driver.md) defines scope.
